chunks.content: Outpatient consultation hours are 09:00 AM to 09:00 PM daily. The Emergency Department and ICU operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
General physician consultation fee is 800 BDT, and specialist cardiology or neurology consultation fee is 1,500 BDT.
Patients can reschedule or cancel an appointment free of charge up to 6 hours before the scheduled slot. Missed appointments without notice incur a 200 BDT rebooking fee.
Digital diagnostic lab reports (CBC, lipid profile, thyroid panel) are delivered online within 12 hours via the patient portal using SMS OTP verification.
We accept cash, Visa, Mastercard, bKash, Nagad, and corporate health insurance cashless cards from MetLife and Pragati Life.
Prescription medicines require a valid doctor prescription upload before pharmacy dispatch. Temperature-sensitive vaccines are transported in cold-chain boxes between 2°C and 8°C.
Home sample collection for blood and urine tests is available across Dhaka metro between 07:00 AM and 11:00 AM for a 300 BDT home visit charge.
Unopened non-refrigerated medicines can be returned within 7 days of purchase with the original printed PDF invoice.
Annual Executive Health Checkup package costs 6,500 BDT and includes fasting blood sugar, lipid profile, ECG, chest X-ray, and physician review.
Patient medical records are encrypted and strictly confidential; records are released only to the verified patient or an authorized family guardian.
